data.name: ConsoleHelp
data.value:
How you go take am: ftps-server [options] ftps-server --config <path-to-json>
Wetin you fit set:
--help Show dis help.
--config <path> JSON file wey hold di setup.
--ip <address> IP address wey e go listen for. Di default na 0.0.0.0. 0.0.0.0, :: and ::0 dey listen for every IPv4 and IPv6 interface.
--port <number> Port wey e go listen for. Di default na 2121. Wetin dey allowed: 2121-65535.
--maxconnections <number> How many connection fit dey at once. Di default na 10. Wetin dey allowed: 2-100.
--cert <path> File wey be certificate (.pfx, .pem or .der). If password dey, .pfx file go open with --certpass.
--certpass <password> Password wey di certificate file get.
--certstorename <name> Name of di store: AuthRoot, CertificateAuthority, My, Root or TrustedPublisher. Put am together with --certstorelocation and --certstoresubject.
--certstorelocation <location> Where di store dey: CurrentUser or LocalMachine. Put am together with --certstorename and --certstoresubject.
--certstoresubject <subject> Subject name wey you wan find for di certificate store. Put am together with --certstorename and --certstorelocation.
--user <login#password#folder#permissions> E go add one user. Permission: R (read), W (write) or RW. Di folda must don dey already. No put # inside di four fields.
Example dem: ftps-server --config settings.json ftps-server --ip 0.0.0.0 --port 2121 --user "admin#secret#C:\ftp\admin#RW" ftps-server --cert server.pfx --certpass secret
If you no put argument, appsettings.json for di current folda go load if di file dey. If user never set, interactive setup go start.
